comparison.objective: Depress an RJ45 spring latch, withdraw a marked plug from a crowded panel, align and insert it into another port, re-engage the latch, and preserve six neighboring connections; candidate separates loose finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained clip depression, retained withdrawal, cable-obstacle management, precise connector alignment/insertion, and latch engagement versus bimanual screen lifting, agitation, selective aperture transit, and support reseating.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires release before withdrawal, source disconnection, target insertion >8 mm with <1 mm lateral error and <5° angle, hook retention, neighbors undisturbed, and a 2 s released hold; candidate requires mass recovery, washer retention, no spill or invalid passage, supported screen, and a 3 s clear-hand dwell. Connector geometry is approximate, but the rubric is sufficient to distinguish the ability.
comparison.reason: Crowded connector unlatching and precision reinsertion test constrained mating and latch mechanics, not selective bulk separation through a screen.
